data.body: Investigation assessment: This ticket describes a fundamental design gap in the local-session loop for merge-to-main-pr.sh, not a discrete code defect. The ticket itself documents 4 possible fix paths (interactive-mode flag, local-dispatch shim, separate phase commands, or skill-orchestrated loop) with the recommendation being Path 4 — a new /dso:finalize-pr skill that owns the CI loop. This scope is beyond a fix-bug patch; it requires /dso:brainstorm before implementation. Transitioning back to open for design routing.
